=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:3,199-200,218-219,241-248,269-270 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `GITHUB_OUTPUT` is never given a safe default, so `set -u` makes the helper crash on the first output write outside GitHub Actions.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers reported unbound-variable failures on `${GITHUB_OUTPUT}` writes in non-Actions/local invocations, though one reviewer treated this as defense-in-depth only.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:41-52 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `conclusion_allowed()` reuses `allowed` as both the array name and the loop variable, corrupting iteration over allowed conclusions.
  WHY: Reviewers reported this can reject valid outcomes like `skipped` for `update_workflows`; one reviewer verified it as correct, so the disagreement is on the bug claim, not the highest-severity assessment.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:72-78 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The retry backoff changed from linear to exponential, increasing delays much faster than the prior behavior.
  WHY: Under repeated API failures this can burn through the timeout budget sooner; one reviewer verified the new formula as intentional, so this is a disputed regression report.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:97-168 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Each `--flag value` parser case reads `$2` and shifts 2 without checking that a value exists.
  WHY: A trailing flag such as `--repo` crashes under `set -u`/`set -e` instead of emitting a usage error.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:195-211 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `PRE_RUN_ID` from the API is interpolated into the `jq` filter without validating that it is numeric.
  WHY: Malformed API output can make `jq` reject the filter and force fallback behavior instead of cleanly handling the registration window.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:229-270 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `RUN_JSON` can be empty, but both snapshot and polling paths still pipe it directly to `jq` without an emptiness guard.
  WHY: Empty or failed API responses produce silenced parse errors and can resolve status/conclusion to defaults; reviewers disagreed on how severe this is, ranging from edge-case noise to a higher-severity misclassification risk.
- scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:53-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `GH_API_SAFE_QUIET_STDERR=1 gh_api_safe "$@"` leaks quiet mode into later shell calls, suppressing stderr on subsequent non-quiet helper invocations.
  WHY: Reviewers reported that mixing quiet and non-quiet API helpers in the same shell hides real GitHub API diagnostics; one reviewer argued the assignment is localized, so the leak claim is disputed.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1405-1472 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The workflow's review-wait-loop callsites can inherit the helper's quiet-state leak and suppress later API errors in the same shell context.
  WHY: This is the callsite-level consequence of the quiet-mode bug, reducing visibility into failures in the mixed quiet/non-quiet API sequence.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "reuse the existing `scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh` helper instead of keeping more inline `gh_api_safe()` copies, and extract the repeated dispatch/watch flow into a permanent shared helper at `scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The helper was created and inline copies/dispatch blocks were removed, but `scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh` still has unresolved runtime bugs (`GITHUB_OUTPUT`, `conclusion_allowed`, parser bounds, `PRE_RUN_ID`, `RUN_JSON`, quiet-state leak) that prevent it from functioning as the intended shared implementation.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Line: 3
  Problem: `set -euo pipefail` is enabled but `GITHUB_OUTPUT` is never initialized.
  Why it fails at runtime: When the script runs outside GitHub Actions, the first write to `${GITHUB_OUTPUT}` crashes with an unbound-variable error under `set -u`.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Lines: 97-157
  Problem: Every `--flag` case in the argument parser reads `$2` and shifts two positions without verifying that a second argument exists.
  Why it fails at runtime: A call like `./script.sh --repo` crashes with an unbound-variable error and a failed `shift 2` instead of a usage diagnostic.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Lines: 41-52
  Problem: In `conclusion_allowed()`, the array variable `allowed` is shadowed by the loop variable `allowed`.
  Why it fails at runtime: The loop may iterate incorrectly and reject valid conclusions such as `skipped`, causing the helper to exit with an error.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Line: 72
  Problem: The retry backoff changed from the original linear behavior to exponential.
  Why it fails at runtime: Under repeated API failures, the exponential backoff consumes the timeout budget much faster than intended and can make the script give up early.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Line: 195
  Problem: `PRE_RUN_ID` is captured from an external API call without validating that it is numeric before being interpolated into the jq filter.
  Why it fails at runtime: A non-numeric value or error message can make the jq filter fail to compile, causing a runtime error and forcing the registration fallback path.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Lines: 229-262
  Problem: In both the snapshot-only path and the completion polling path, the script pipes possibly empty `RUN_JSON` directly to `jq` without checking for emptiness first.
  Why it fails at runtime: Empty or malformed input triggers jq parse errors and can fall back to incorrect default values for STATUS/CONCLUSION.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh
  Lines: 55, 62
  Problem: The `gh_api_safe_quiet()` and `gh_api_safe_quiet_print()` functions use prefix assignment that persists the variable in the sourced shell after the function returns.
  Why it fails at runtime: Later non-quiet `gh_api_safe` calls can inherit `GH_API_SAFE_QUIET_STDERR=1`, suppressing stderr output and hiding real GitHub API failures.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "reuse the existing `scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh` helper instead of keeping more inline `gh_api_safe()` copies, and extract the repeated dispatch/watch flow into a permanent shared helper at `scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh`."
  Expected change site: The new helper script `scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh`
  Evidence of absence: The inline duplication was removed and replaced with calls to the new helper, but the helper itself contains multiple unresolved runtime bugs that prevent it from functioning as a shared implementation.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  Why it fails at runtime: Any output redirection aborts the script before it can do useful work when run outside GitHub Actions.

  Why it fails at runtime: API blips or unexpected output can produce a jq parse error and trigger the fail-open path even when a run was created.

  Lines: 51-67
  Problem: `GH_API_SAFE_QUIET_STDERR=1` leaks across calls and suppresses error output on later non-quiet invocations.
  Why it fails at runtime: Subsequent GitHub API failures lose stderr diagnostics, reducing visibility during retries.
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Lines: 229-262
  Problem: `RUN_JSON` may be empty but is still piped directly to `jq` in both the snapshot and polling paths.
  Why it fails at runtime: Empty input produces parse errors and can misclassify workflow status or conclusion.
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Lines: 97-168
  Problem: Every `--flag) VALUE="$2"; shift 2;;` case reads `$2` without guarding that the second argument exists.
  Why it fails at runtime: A trailing flag without a value crashes with an unbound-variable or shift error instead of a clean usage message.
- File: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh
  Line: 74-78
  Problem: The retry backoff changed from linear to exponential.
  Why it fails at runtime: The new delays consume the timeout budget too aggressively and can make the helper give up before enough retries.
- Requirement: "reuse the existing `scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh` helper"
  Expected change site: `scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh`
  Evidence of absence: The helper exists, but it still contains the runtime defects above, so it is not yet a safe shared implementation.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "extract repeated dispatch/watch flow into permanent shared helper"
  Expected change site: `scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh`
  Evidence of absence: The new helper is present, but the unresolved runtime bugs prevent it from safely satisfying the intended contract.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
